utf16: raw 16-bit units; no encoding fallback, normalization, BOM handling or surrogate validation

capture.tail: raw command line, cwd, image path, environment block: each u32 code-unit length then that many u16; then u32 argc followed by argc length-prefixed u16 strings

fieldRules.image: 1..32767 units, no embedded NUL; path only, not byte identity
fieldRules.environment: 2..131072 units inclusive of final double NUL; no earlier double NUL; order/duplicates/empty values/drive pseudoentries preserved
fieldRules.argv: 0..4096 strings, each0..32767 non-NUL units, explicitly CommandLineToArgvW interpretation; raw command remains authoritative received text

errors.255: managed/API I/O exception; no invented native error detail

errorPrecedence.source: first thrown operation in execution order; failure in environment/argv finally cleanup supersedes prior capture exception; failure-marker errors do not overwrite retained partial files and lead to hold/watchdog; unhandled startup/OS termination remains unobservable
binary: header fields/truncation then identity then reserved
in serialized field order: length truncation, unit bound, empty required field, payload truncation, NUL/terminator checks

arbitration: durable exclusively created entry-PID-CREATION.bin before fixed winner.bin CREATE_NEW. Only successful durable winner proceeds. Every existing-winner loser publishes its own failure marker and holds. Same identity entry collision publishes a failure marker. Never elect a new winner after partial/stale lock.
observability: registeredAttempts counts valid entry files; totalAttempts always null. Pre-entry faults, termination during entry publication and failure-marker errors prevent exact process-attempt completeness. No receipt upgrades one visible entry to one attempt.
publication: completion marker only after record Write/Flush(true)/Dispose success. Supervisor must acquire marker with FileShare.None after recorder closes, then terminate whole job. Validate all final raw files only after bounded cleanup; live marker is only a stop hint.
terminal: winner, loser and every caught failure hold without returning to producer; whole-job termination required. No output launch, forwarding, subprocess or response-file expansion.
runtimeGates: exact helper build proposal and separate approval
compiled binary hash and compiler/API verification
separate benign lifecycle/race/fault tests with independent child census
complete fresh-root staging and controller integration plus source hashes
unresolved: C# compilation, platform APIs and quoting behavior untested
no independent complete process census; exact attempts cannot be established
FileStream flush/Dispose and concurrent Windows semantics not runtime-tested
proposed controller has an unconditional source gate and still needs recorder staging/pinned binary/full contract integration
no prevention of alternate producer subprocesses, outside writers or external reads
